title: METAIS manifest
description: The manifest of a METAIS 1.0 package: its identity, its versions, the guide for suppliers, its inputs and its outputs. Every object is closed, and no member is ever null: an optional member is omitted. The SPDX grammar of license, the uniqueness of input names and output ids, and the nesting of for_each are manifest rules the specification states and this schema does not express.

metais.title: Specification version
metais.description: The METAIS specification version the package targets, as a quoted string. A tool processes the package under exactly that version's rules.

name.title: Package name
name.description: The package's name: lower-case ASCII segments of letters and digits joined by single hyphens, the segments joined by dots, such as org.example.vpat-acr. A segment is at most 63 characters, and the leading segment is not a Windows device name.

version.title: Package version
version.description: The package's own version, a Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version such as 1.2.0, written without a leading v and quoted. Pre-release and build metadata are allowed.

title.title: Title
title.description: What the package is, as a person names it: one line of 1 to 200 characters.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the package produces, in a sentence or a short paragraph of 1 to 1000 characters, displayed verbatim.

guide.title: Guide
guide.description: The guide for suppliers, in CommonMark, of 1 to 16384 characters: what the package is for, how its inputs relate, the order in which to gather them, and where to read further.

authors.title: Authors
authors.description: The package's authors, 1 to 64 of them: people or organizations.

license.title: License
license.description: The terms of the package's own content, as an SPDX license expression of 1 to 512 characters, with the operators AND, OR and WITH in upper case.

homepage.title: Homepage
homepage.description: The package's home page, an absolute https or http URI with a host and no user information. No command ever fetches it.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The inputs the package takes, in the order a supplier meets them. It may be empty.

input_constraints.title: Input constraints
input_constraints.description: The package path, under inputs/, of a schema evaluated against the object holding every input, for rules that relate one input to another.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: The output declarations, in the order they are planned. There is at least one.

line.description: A line: text of at least one character with no control character, neither beginning nor ending with a space.

prose.description: Prose: text of at least one character whose only control characters are line feeds and tabs, neither beginning nor ending with a space, a line feed or a tab.

http_uri.description: An absolute https or http URI of at most 2048 characters, the scheme in lower case, with a non-empty host, no user information and no fragment.

name.title: Author name
name.description: The person or organization: one line of 1 to 200 characters.

email.title: Author email
email.description: An email address of 3 to 254 characters, with exactly one @ and no space. It is not validated further, and no command sends mail.

url.title: Author URL
url.description: The author's web page, an absolute https or http URI with a host and no user information.

inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.description: The data specification: the package's input slots, in order.

input.title: Input
input.description: One input slot: a named place for one piece of data, with its schema.

name.title: Input name
name.description: The input's name: a lower-case letter, then up to 63 lower-case letters, digits and underscores. It is unique among the package's inputs, and is not one of Liquid's reserved words.

title.title: Input title
title.description: What the input is, in brief: one line of 1 to 200 characters.

description.title: Input description
description.description: What the input means, as plain text, line breaks allowed.

schema.title: Input schema
schema.description: The package path, under inputs/, of the input's JSON Schema file, ending .json, .yaml or .yml.

meaning.title: Meaning document
meaning.description: The package path, under inputs/, of a CommonMark document ending .md that says what the data is for and what good data looks like.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: The file forms the input may be supplied in, without repeats. When it is omitted the forms are json and yaml.

csv.title: CSV options
csv.description: How a CSV file of this input is read. Allowed only when forms contains csv.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: The character that separates fields: a comma, a semicolon, a vertical bar or a tab.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Whether the input is a collection: an array of items, supplied as a directory of item files. When it is omitted the input is not a collection.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether the input must be supplied. When it is omitted the input is required.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: The forms of an input with CSV options, which include csv.

outputs.title: Outputs
outputs.description: The output declarations: at least one.

output.title: Output declaration
output.description: One output declaration, of exactly one form, named by the one source key it carries: template, asset, mirror or container.

entry.title: Container entry
entry.description: One entry of a zip container: a declaration of one of the output forms, placed inside the container.

template_output.title: Template output
template_output.description: A template output: one file per evaluation, rendered from a template under templates/.

asset_output.title: Asset copy
asset_output.description: An asset copy: a file under assets/, or every file beneath a directory there, copied byte for byte.

mirror_output.title: Mirror
mirror_output.description: A mirror: one rendered file per template beneath a directory under templates/.

container_output.title: Zip container
container_output.description: A zip container: one zip file whose entries are declarations.

template_entry.title: Template entry
template_entry.description: A template output placed in a container.

asset_entry.title: Asset entry
asset_entry.description: An asset copy placed in a container.

mirror_entry.title: Mirror entry
mirror_entry.description: A mirror placed in a container.

container_entry.title: Zip container entry
container_entry.description: A zip container placed in a container.

container.title: Container
container.description: A zip container's shape: its format, its profile, and its entries.

format.title: Container format
format.description: The container's format. zip is the only one.

profile.title: Container profile
profile.description: The packaging rules of a format the container follows: ooxml, odf or epub. Without one, the container is written exactly as declared.

mimetype.title: Media type
mimetype.description: The odf profile's media type, type/subtype in printable ASCII with no whitespace, which the tool writes as the mimetype entry. Required with the odf profile, and allowed only with it.

entries.title: Entries
entries.description: The container's entries, at least one, each a declaration.

id.title: Output id
id.description: The declaration's identifier: a lower-case letter, then up to 63 lower-case letters, digits and underscores. Top-level ids are unique in the manifest, and entry ids within their container.

template.title: Template
template.description: The template's path relative to templates/.

asset.title: Asset
asset.description: The asset's path relative to assets/, a file or a directory; . is the whole of assets/.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.description: The directory relative to templates/ whose every template is rendered; . is the whole of templates/.

path.title: Path
path.description: The destination, a Liquid template whose rendered text is a path; . is the root of the tree. Required on a container and on a declaration with for_each.

when.title: When
when.description: A Liquid condition: the declaration produces files only where it holds.

for_each.title: For each
for_each.description: A Liquid value expression whose array gives one evaluation per element, bound to item.

escape.title: Escape
escape.description: How values are escaped when rendered: none, the default, or html.

newline.title: Newline
newline.description: The rendered file's line endings: as-written, the default, or crlf.

validate.title: Validate
validate.description: The package path of a JSON Schema the output's final bytes are validated against, anywhere in the package except .compiled/.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The output kind, overriding the one its rendered path gives.

executable.title: Executable
executable.description: Whether the file is written with mode 0755 instead of 0644. Default false.

first.title: First
first.description: Whether the entry's files are placed before every other entry the profile does not place. Default false.

stored.title: Stored
stored.description: Whether the entry's files are stored rather than compressed. Default false.
